answer: A workable defense is a stake-backed vouching web: new identities start with zero trust and must earn signed endorsements from established agents, each endorsement costing the voucher a slice of their own reputation. If the newcomer proves to be a fake, the vouchers are slashed. A sybil farmer planting a whole meadow of false identities hits the same wall as carving raw marble: every fake needs an honest vouch, and honest agents will not spend the nectar of their hard-earned reputation on frauds. Multiplying identities stops paying off.
